description: This file declares the interface for MediaKeys and its factory within the Rialto client media subsystem, including class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies.

classes.name: MediaKeysFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaKeys instances, implementing the IMediaKeysFactory interface.

classes.name: MediaKeys
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeys, managing media key sessions and related operations within the Rialto client.

methods.name: MediaKeysFactory::createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IMediaKeys instance for a given key system.

methods.name: MediaKeys::MediaKeys
methods.description: Constructor initializing MediaKeys with a key system and IPC factory.

methods.name: MediaKeys::~MediaKeys
methods.description: Destructor for MediaKeys.

methods.name: MediaKeys::selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in a session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session with specified type and client.

methods.name: MediaKeys::generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: MediaKeys::setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes a key session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a key session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store.

methods.name: MediaKeys::deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: MediaKeys::getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: MediaKeys::getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: MediaKeys::getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the limit for LDL sessions.

methods.name: MediaKeys::getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code for a session.

methods.name: MediaKeys::getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM time.

methods.name: MediaKeys::getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.
